exposure: patients requiring transfusion vs those not requiring transfusion
cohort: Patients monitored due to postpartum hemorrhage in the 2nd stage intensive care between 1 January 2019-1 January 2020.
finding: The study identified risk factors which predispose peripartum blood transfusion and developed a prediction model with good discrimination.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was statistically significantly associated with a higher rate of blood transfusion.
